title: LOAD1
characteristics_ch1.1: subject group: LOAD (late onset of Alzheimer’s disease)
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted using phenol chloroform method, subjected to Dnase treatment and Riosomal RNA removal using RiboZero
extract_protocol_ch1.1: RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: We performed directional RNA sequencing using Illumina Hiseq 2000. Directional RNAseq was performed running one sample per lane and we generated ~177.000.000 reads per sample
data_processing.1: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence. TopHat wass used to align reads to the human genome, while transcriptome reconstruction of each individual sample was performed using Cufflinks. Reconstructed transcriptomes for each individual samples were compared to each other using Cuffcompare that also merges overlapping constructs and annotates them according to the reference transcriptome provided (Ensembl GRCh37)
data_processing.2: In order to discriminate real transcripts from sequencing artifacts we adopted a filtering strategy based of two main criteria: 1) the presence of at least one splice junction in the transcripts and 2) the recurrent expression of single exon transcripts across multiple samples.
data_processing.4: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Gene Transfer File (.gtf). The gtf file was generated by first performing ab initio reconstruction of transcripts for individual samples with Cufflinks, combining the individual gtf files with Cuffcompare and filtering spurious transcripts. It contain annotation of both coding and non-coding transcripts.
